prompt.zh:
请作为短视频编导，识别核心信息与目标受众。依据我提供的素材和当前可用的工具完成，列出关键依据；必要素材缺失时说明需要补充的信息。

prompt.en:
As the Short-video Director, identify core information and target audiences. Use the materials I provide and currently available tools, include supporting evidence, and identify any essential missing information.
